entries.zh: 仍可退回使用；还可利用
entries.en: it can still be turned back and put to use; one can still profit from it
entries.notes: H 栏第二字于退／迴／返之间存疑，释义结合西语 aprovechar（17 世纪义：利用、得利）推断为「仍可退使／利用」。

entries.zh: 更；更加、愈甚
entries.en: even more; still more; furthermore

entries.zh: 或者；也许、有时（即便最大者亦非总是有害）
entries.en: or; perhaps; sometimes — even the greatest is not always harmful

entries.zh: 雖；虽然、即使
entries.en: although; even if; though

entries.zh: 虽然；虽然如此、即便如此
entries.en: although; even so, even though it be so

entries.zh: 虽是；虽然（如此）
entries.en: even though it is; although it be so

entries.zh: 不曾；尚未、还没（做过）
entries.en: not yet; never (has done)

entries.zh: 尚未完备、仍有欠缺
entries.en: not yet perfected or completed; still lacking
entries.notes: 汉字「不空」与西语 aun no está perfeccionado（尚未完成）之间需推断，「空」取欠缺、未成之义。

entries.zh: 尚未做成、还未完成（闽南口语短语）
entries.en: not yet finished / made complete (Hokkien colloquial phrase)
entries.notes: 「膠羅成」字面不透明，据西语对应条 aun no está perfeccionado 及 position 8 同类条推断为「尚未完成」之义。

entries.zh: 終有；终究还有、最后仍有
entries.en: in the end there is / there will be; finally still

entries.zh: 卯（地支第四位）；卯时，清晨五至七时，黎明
entries.en: the fourth earthly branch; the mao hour (5–7 a.m.), dawn

entries.zh: 卯时；清晨五至七时（黎明时分）
entries.en: the hour of mao (5–7 a.m.); dawn time

entries.zh: 天坪白（天色转白之时）；黎明、破晓
entries.en: when the sky turns pale white; dawn / daybreak (crepuscule)

entries.zh: 疏阔；久别、久疏音问
entries.en: long absence; long separation, estrangement

entries.zh: 不在处；不在（某处）、不在家
entries.en: not to be present / not to be there; absent

entries.zh: 后面；背后、身后
entries.en: behind; at the back (of him)

entries.zh: 断线风筝（喻久出不归、音信全无之人）；一去不返
entries.en: a kite with its string cut — metaphor for one gone a long time and never seen again

entries.zh: 威；威严、威望（人的威仪）
entries.en: authority; majesty; awe-inspiring dignity of a man

entries.zh: 名公（有名望、有地位之人）；名望、声誉
entries.en: a man of name and standing; authority and fame

entries.zh: 敕；皇帝敕令、敕命，敕封
entries.en: imperial edict / royal mandate; to decree, to command

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original damaged/blank; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 该条为字母 A 分部标题（A. ante.），H 栏[空]、R 栏[空]，无实词可释。

entries.zh: 弈（或作奕）；下棋、弈棋（西语 xedres＝ajedrez，棋戏）
entries.en: to play chess; chess (Sp. ajedrez)
entries.notes: 「弈」字在弈／奕之间存疑，且 M 栏「liōs」未对应汉字，释义主要依西语词头 xedres 与汉字「弈」。

entries.zh: 棋；棋子、棋局（西语 ajedrez，指国际象棋）
entries.en: chess (Sp. ajedrez); chess piece / game of chess
